messages:
Jordan: Hey team — first-week question. Trying to build runtime from source on my ARM64 dev box (Ubuntu 22.04, gcc 12) following the docs. Ran:
```
cmake -B build -DWITH_CUDA=ON -DCUDA_TOOLKIT_ROOT_DIR=/usr/local/cuda-12.2 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ..
ninja -C build
```
Link fails with:
```
[100%] Linking CXX shared library libredwood_runtime.so
/usr/bin/ld: .../build/runtime/libredwood_runtime.so: relocation R_AARCH64_ADR_PREL_PG_HI21 against symbol `some_kernel' cannot be used when making a shared object; recompile with -fPIC
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```
Anyone seen this on arm64? Who should I ping?

rosie: hey jordan, welcome! That error is the classic non-PIC object in a shared lib. Try adding `-DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=ON` to your cmake invocation. Also check any third-party static libs (.a) — they need to be built with -fPIC.

mika: also check if any of our generated code (protos, codegen) was built earlier by CI/tooling on x86 and copied over — static objs from x86 or without PIC will break linking on aarch64.

rosie: fwiw for CUDA objects you usually need relocatable device code for linking into shared libs. Add nvcc flags: `-rdc=true` and pass `-Xcompiler -fPIC` so device host objects are PIC-friendly. In CMakeLists: set `CUDA_NVCC_FLAGS` or target_compile_options for the cuda target.

samir: if you keep hitting weird relocations, try linking with lld on aarch64 — it's more forgiving for some reloc types. `apt install lld` and set `-DCMAKE_LINKER=lld -D CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS='-fuse-ld=lld'` or use `-fuse-ld=lld` in added flags.

build-bot: FYI CI job that hit similar failure: https://ci.internal/redwood/branches/main/1234 — same R_AARCH64_ADR_PREL_PG_HI21 in build logs.

Jordan: I tried `-DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=ON`, rebuilt deps that were .a with `-fPIC`, and updated nvcc flags (`-Xcompiler -fPIC -rdc=true`). Re-ran and build finished ✅. Thanks for the quick tips!

rosie: :tada: awesome. Welcome aboard. If you want I can add a short checklist to the eng-runtime onboarding docs: arm64 notes (force PIC for deps, nvcc relocatable code, consider LLD).

Jordan: will do a small PR to docs after I finish the onboarding checklist. Thanks again!
